race.description: Izzy's Gift Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: CAPE EX (1) stalked the leader but had no answer to his turn of foot last start over 1100m at Nowra. Meets a plain line-up today so despite coming back in trip he should race handy and prove tough to stop at the third run of the prep. DREAMTOWN (5) last raced in March 2025 and is now in a new yard. Showed glimpses of talent at her only two runs. Trialled well at Wagga recently and should give a good account against ordinary opposition. OTENBA (7) battled on well but was gapped by the winner on debut last start over this distance at Corowa. Likely improver who just needs a bit of luck from a poor gate. BRUTAL TO THE MAX (10) is a 21-start maiden who is only worth considering for wider exotics. First starter MIDLETON BABE (3) hasn't set the world on fire at the trials. Market watch.
